title: Southern Grove | Pet Friendly 30A Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Designer 6-bedroom Seagrove home with private heated pool, Eastern Lake access, bikes and LSV, pet friendly, minutes to the beach and dining.
description_expanded: Southern Grove Features - Designer home built in 2023 - 2 Min bike ride or LSV (golf cart) ride to the Eastern Lake Beach Access. The coastal dune Eastern Lake flows into the Gulf at this beach entrance, a rare ecological phenomenon only found in 4 countries including the USA. You can visit 15 of these artisan spring fed lakes on 30A. - 4 Min LSV (golf cart) ride to Walton Dunes Beach Access. Beach service available at this entrance. - Private Pool - can be heated for an additional fee for reservations October - April - Access to a 6-Seater LSV (golf cart) from La Dolce Vita. Some restrictions apply and must sign waiver to use cart during your stay - Enjoy exploring 30A on 6 Taxi bikes, included with your stay - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 45-pounds or less. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee is required prior to your arrival. Unauthorized pets will result in fines and possible eviction - Lounge chairs, umbrella, and Adirondack seating poolside on the sundeck - Outdoor Summer Kitchen with built-in gas grill - Outdoor dining for 8 on the back patio - Patio with lounge seating overlooking the pool deck - 1st Floor Main living area with plush sectional sofa and large Smart TV - Chef inspired kitchen with high-end stainless-steel appliances plus a drip and Keurig coffee maker - 1st Floor Dining area with seating for 8 plus breakfast bar seating for 6 - 1st floor Mud room with HE washer and dryer, storage center for beach and pool supplies, large beverage fridge, and stand-alone ice maker - King suite on the 1st floor plus 4 additional king suites on the 2nd floor - 1 Min bike ride or LSV (golf cart) ride to Greenway Station with many shopping and dining options including Turbo Coffee, Free People, Coast Hippie, and Local Cantina - Laundry rooms on the 1st and 2nd floor - Fubo TV streaming service (440+ local and national channels) and WIFI available - 3rd floor game room with a wet bar plus mini-fridge, lounge area, foosball table, and large TV plus a second TV above the wet bar - 2nd floor covered balcony with Adirondack seating and ceiling fans for year-round comfort - The home is located next to Eastern Lake, and ramp access is nearby on Lakewood Dr. This rare coastal lake flows into the Gulf and is ideal for kayaks, paddle boards, and fishing. - Fishing licenses and equipment rentals available at nearby Yellowfin Ocean Sports, only a 2-minute bike ride from the home - Powder Rooms on the 1st and 3rd floor - Driveway parking for 4 sedans or 3 SUVs - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee - Concierge services available, including grocery delivery, eBike rentals, catered beach bonfires, and more! - Front door has a doorbell camera for security Welcome to our stunning 6-bedroom pet-friendly oasis nestled next to Eastern Lake and a 2 min bike ride from the pristine sands of the beach. This luxurious coastal retreat offers the ultimate blend of comfort, convenience, and recreation, ensuring an unforgettable vacation experience. As you step into this designer home, you're greeted by a spacious and inviting living area adorned with coastal-inspired professionally designed decor and ample seating, perfect for relaxing after a day of sun-soaked adventures. The fully equipped gourmet kitchen beckons aspiring chefs to create culinary delights. Step outside to discover your private oasis, featuring a sparkling pool a summer kitchen. Unwind on the spacious deck with a cold drink in hand, while the kids frolic in the pool while the pup runs around the fenced-in back yard. Grill up local seafood in the summer kitchen and dine al fresco under the umbrella. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
